title: Job's Testing
summary: Job, a blameless and wealthy man in the land of Uz, offers sacrifices for his children. In heaven Satan tells God that Job fears him only because he is protected, and God lets Satan take Job's goods but not touch him. In one day messengers report the loss of his oxen, donkeys, sheep, camels and servants and of all his children. Job worships. Satan then strikes him with boils, his wife urges him to curse God, and he refuses. Three friends come and sit with him in silence for seven days.

title: Elihu Speaks
summary: After the three friends stop answering Job because he is righteous in his own eyes, Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, younger than them all, becomes angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God, and with the three friends for condemning Job without an answer. He explains that he waited because of their age, but says wisdom comes from the spirit in a person, not only from years, and that he is full of words and must speak.

title: God Answers from the Whirlwind
summary: The LORD answers Job out of the whirlwind with questions: where he was when the earth's foundations were laid, who shut up the sea, who sends rain and lightning, and who feeds the lion and the raven. He asks about the mountain goat, the wild donkey, the ostrich, the horse and the hawk. Job puts his hand on his mouth. The LORD then describes Behemoth and Leviathan as creatures beyond human control and asks, 'Who then is able to stand before me?'

title: Job Restored
summary: Job answers the LORD that he knows God can do everything and that he spoke of things he did not understand, and he repents in dust and ashes. The LORD tells Eliphaz that he and his friends have not spoken of him rightly as Job has, and tells them to offer seven bulls and seven rams with Job praying for them. After Job prays, the LORD restores his fortunes and doubles his possessions. He has seven sons and three daughters and lives 140 more years.
